sanskrit_verse:
प्रसह्य हरणाद् उक्तो विवाहो राक्षसस् तथा।
सुप्तमत्तोपगमनात् पैशाचस् त्वष्टमोऽधमः॥
transliteration: prasahya haraṇād ukto vivāho rākṣasas tathā | suptamattopagamanāt paiśācas tv aṣṭamo 'dhamaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The union born of forcible seizure is declared Rakshasa marriage; that which occurs through approach upon one asleep or intoxicated is deemed the lowest, Pisacha form—both are deviations from Dharma and require immediate restoration of consent, sovereignty, and conscious alignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in conscious consent, never in coercive act
Causation arises from violation of sovereign will
Capacity-based responsibility demands restoration of violated integrity
Restoration logic requires dissolution of non-consensual bond
Consciousness alignment necessitates purification of relational field
executable_legal_axioms: IF marriage_classification IN ['rakshasa', 'paishacha'] THEN execute_dissolution_protocol AND restore_individual_sovereignty
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any marital union established under coercion or without capacity for consent shall be automatically nullified. The court must invoke dissolution protocols and ensure full restoration of individual autonomy prior to further proceedings.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals force and incapacity as root causes; anupurvasah shows sequential distortion of dharma-sankalpa; proportional responsibility lies with violator of sankalpa-shakti; non-punitive reality rule declares harm as illusion to be dissolved through realignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate dissolution of invalid marital contract
Restore personal sovereignty through affirmation rituals
Realign energetic bonds via conscious completion process
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Forcible unions are void. Consciousness is the ultimate judge. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive.
